# Adversarial Test Results (§31)

**33 adversarial tests, all passing** — `33 passed in 1.46s`

§31 asks for ten difficult tests and for documentation of how the system responds. Every row below is an assertion that runs in CI, not a description of intended behaviour. "It didn't throw" is not counted as a defence.

Where a defence is marked **structural**, it is enforced by a permission check, a schema validator or a comparison in the router — it holds regardless of what any model was persuaded to emit. Where it is **instructional**, it is prompt wording and is therefore the last line of defence, never the only one. A row with no kind asserts that an attack is *reachable* rather than asserting a defence — a defence whose attack cannot be reproduced is untested.

| # | Attack | Defence | Kind | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | two corpus documents assert opposite facts (planted defect PD1). | retrieval surfaces both sides on one query, so the Critic can see the conflict. A system that only ever retrieves one side cannot detect a contradiction, and the contradiction metric would be vacuous. | **structural** | `test_a1_conflicting_sources_are_both_retrievable` |

## Coverage against §31's listed scenarios

| §31 scenario | Covered by |
|---|---|
| Conflicting sources | A1 — both sides of planted defect PD1 retrievable together |
| Missing information | A2 — empty search returns zero hits with guidance |
| Unsupported certainty | A3 — schema rejects uncited major claims |
| No useful evidence | A2b — handoff must declare a gap |
| Invalid agent output | A4 — cyclic plan fails cleanly, no deadlock |
| Critic rejects repeatedly | A5 — terminates at the cap, objections in the report |
| Search tool fails | A6 — error fed back to the agent, corpus outage handled |
| Prompt injection | A7 — corpus payload plus request-level guard |
| Duplicate research task | A8 — collapsed deterministically, dependents rewired |
| User changes objective | A10 — plan rejection aborts before research |
| Runaway loops / cost | A9 — every loop has a finite, tested cap |
| Agent impersonation | A11 — SYSTEM identity cannot call tools |
